snippet.title: Mega Man: Wily Tower NES - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Follow my projects here: https://bsky.app/profile/thatentitygirl.bsky.social

DOWNLOAD Wily Tower NES here: https://www.sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/mega-man-wily-tower-nes-sage-26.3258/

The 8-bit demake of Wily Tower is finally finished! Play through the Wily Tower mode from Mega Man: The Wily Wars as a standalone game, with modern quality of life features and bonus content! It includes a playable Proto Man and Bass, optional "improved" versions of the weapons, bonus stages, extra bosses, a boss rush mode, cheats and more!
